theme: Cold War intelligence heist (1959): CIA operatives covertly intercept, crate-pry, disassemble, photograph, and reassemble a Soviet Lunik (Luna 1/2) upper-stage probe overnight in a Mexican salvage yard. The emotional arc moves from shadowy espionage dread and clandestine mechanical tension (130 turnbuckle bolts, delicate Soviet inspection seals, blue-pencil markings) into rising technical awe at the payload reveal, culminating in a breathless dawn sprint to return the sealed crate undetected to the exhibition railhead.

act_1_cold_open.cue: Colossal crate arrives at Mexican salvage yard; covert inspection team mounts roof

act_2_recon.cue: Exhibition surveillance, manifest interception, tracking the transport convoy

act_3_heist_turn.cue: Convoy intercepted, salvage gates lock; unbolting 130 access fasteners in the dark

act_4_payload_operation.cue: Payload revealed; duplicating the Soviet stamp seal and logging wire bindings

act_5_markings_climax.cue: Technical Markings Center breakthrough: real flight hardware verified; reassembly race

outro_dawn_resolution.cue: Dawn return to railhead untouched; quiet historical legacy of declassified mission
